places.de: A border bridge connecting France and Germany across the Rhine River, holding great symbolism for European unity.
places.tp: يمكنك المشي أو استخدام الدراجة لقطع الجسر والوقوف في البلدين بنفس النزهة.
places.tpe: You can walk or cycle across the bridge and stand in both countries during the same stroll.

places.de: A historic cultural building constructed in the early 20th century hosting musical and artistic events.
places.tp: راجع جدول العروض الفنية والحفلات الموسيقية لحجز تذكرتك مسبقاً إن وجدت.
places.tpe: Check the schedule of artistic performances and concerts to book your ticket in advance if available.
